enabled.description: Master switch for QoS Builder. Ships OFF: install it, look around, then turn it on when you want confirmed placement jobs from the CoI Companion website to execute. While off, job files are not even scanned — they wait in the jobs folder and expire (30 minutes after confirm).

log_jobs.description: Write game-log lines for claimed, scheduled and refused jobs (with the refusal reason). The QoS activity feed records the same events regardless — see QoSCore's activity_log_enabled setting.

max_items_per_job.description: Hard cap on blueprint size this mod will place, whatever a job file asks for. A job also carries its own cap from the confirm step; the lower of the two rules.
